headline: Key Models for OpenAPI Specification
what_breaks: fastapi/openapi/utils.py — relies on Info and Schema classes
why: This file defines critical data models used throughout FastAPI's OpenAPI implementation. Changes to these models can impact multiple components that depend on them for validation and schema generation.
checklist: Review changes to BaseModelWithConfig and its subclasses.
Check for any modifications to EmailStr and its validation logic.
Ensure compatibility with dependent files like fastapi/params.py and fastapi/security/base.py.
Update any relevant documentation related to OpenAPI models.
